message.content: I usually wake up around six in the morning, like a clock. I have some yoghurt for breakfast, then I get dressed and ride my bike to the bakery. The bike ride is pretty short, maybe ten minutes. I like the routine because it feels calm. Sometimes, when I'm on the bike, I hear a voice, but it doesn't last long. I just keep going. At the bakery, I start by labeling the bread trays. Then I wrap the loaves and clean the counter. The work is steady, and that helps me feel more in control.
